response.query: What de-identification steps for geospatial data and a timeline for releasing controlled-access sensitive files will be included in the data-sharing plan?
response.answer: De-identification of geospatial data involves removing location identifiers. Controlled-access sensitive files will be released quarterly starting six months post-data collection. Compliance with privacy regulations is mandatory.
